observation: The H1 is a very large 64px bold uppercase headline. It wraps to two lines in a tight line-height and sits to the right of the logo in the hero.

observation: Small uppercase labels with wide letter-spacing are used for the eyebrow ('LIQUI-MOLY BATHURST 12 HOUR'), 'FEATURED NEWS', 'READ MORE →', 'OUR PARTNERS', and the nav items. This gives a consistent label style in bold red or white.
evidence: Visible tracked uppercase text in the hero, the featured card and the partners heading; h4 'OUR PARTNERS'

observation: The top nav is a horizontal bar of seven uppercase bold links. Two-word items ('THE EVENT', 'THE RACE', 'PREVIOUS RACES', 'BUSHFIRES APPEAL') wrap onto two lines, so the spacing between items is uneven. The bar has a thin bottom border and a small logo at the left.
evidence: nav count 1; header 1; screenshot header slice shows wrapped 'THE / EVENT'; header logo 41x48 at x146,y8

observation: The page has a 'Menu' button with a transparent background, a 4px radius and 8px 12px padding. It is not visible at desktop width, so it is probably a mobile toggle that is hidden here. It is the only button on the page.

observation: The hero is a left-aligned two-column composition. A large logo (150x173) sits on the left. The background is a dark diagonal red and blue light-streak graphic. A red rule closes the hero.

observation: The page is contained in a centred column about 1148px wide, with left and right edges at x≈146 and x≈1294 on a 1440px viewport. The header, news, follow and partners sections all share these edges.

observation: The footer is minimal. A hairline divider is followed by the small logo and a copyright line, '© 2021 LIQUI-MOLY Bathurst 12 Hour. All Rights Reserved', on the left. On the right are four small grey text links: Contacts, Media, Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions.

observation: Decoration is restrained. There are no box shadows, no CSS gradients, no animations and no transforms. There is one backdrop blur, which probably belongs to the translucent sticky header, rgba(14,15,18,0.94). Corners are mostly square, with 26 elements at a 1-7px radius.
